text:
akiko: RFC follow-up: proposing a 'phased splice' migration for the request-enrichment surface. Idea: don't cut the monolith out in one go. Insert a tiny splice that can forward, mirror, or normalize traffic so new enrichment svc can onboard tenants gradually. Goals: lower risk, permit canaries, and keep routing reversible.

dave: quick perf check  what's the median added latency on the hot path?

akiko: micro-adapter should add ~1ms median, up to ~4ms under auth lookup. We'll measure in the spike.

rachel: parity detection  hash diffs are noisy for fuzzy responses. We should combine hash sampling with semantic checks and downstream label parity.

akiko: agreed. Plan: 1) 1% sampled response-hash, 2) semantic eval for flagged prompts, 3) nightly deterministic regressions. Auto-pause if semantic-diff >0.2%.

dave: KV incompatibilities are a big one. Splice must normalize keys and emulate old eviction behavior during transition.

akiko: yes  splice will expose a compatibility shim with per-tenant modes and a feature-flag toggle.

ops-bot: Created TKT-998: "feature-proxy: per-tenant splice flags + invalidation". Owner: infra-oncall. ETA: 72h.

rachel: rollout policy suggestion: start 0.5% per-tenant, multiplier 1.4 every 30m, max 100%. Include token-bucket guard so we can cap absolute qps.

akiko: will add that. Also adding X-Migration-Id header for tracing and an ops dash showing percent routed, diff-heatmap, and migration state.

dave: tests: integrate KV skew, latency spikes, and rollback triggers into the harness. Run load tests with varied prompt sizes.

akiko: adding test matrix and rollback playbook to the RFC addendum. Will post EOD. Thanks for the quick feedback.
